# MoneyVeda — Indian Market Commentary, Chart Patterns & Financial Calculators
> https://www.moneyveda.org

MoneyVeda is a free Indian personal-finance and markets site. No signup, no login, no paywall.
It has three sections: daily Nifty market commentary, a daily candlestick pattern scanner for
NSE stocks, and a suite of India-specific financial calculators.

## Site Structure

- https://www.moneyveda.org/ — Market Pulse: live Nifty 50 commentary (the homepage)
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns — Candlestick scanner across NSE stocks
- https://www.moneyveda.org/calculators — Financial calculator suite
- https://www.moneyveda.org/accuracy-dashboard — Track record of past signals

## Market Pulse (https://www.moneyveda.org/)
Live Nifty commentary for retail Indian investors, Monday to Friday.
- Pre-market cues at 08:00 IST, intraday updates every 30 minutes from 09:30, post-market wrap at 17:00 IST
- Plain-English stock commentary across all 100 Nifty constituents, searchable by name or symbol
- Live prices, top movers, corporate filings, and news sentiment
- Bullish / bearish / watch signal tags
- Educational only; not SEBI-registered investment advice

## Candlestick Patterns (https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns)
A daily scan of NSE stocks for sixteen candlestick formations, run after every market close.

How the scan works — this is what distinguishes it from generic pattern screeners:
- Detection uses TA-Lib CDL functions on daily OHLC data
- A reversal pattern is only listed when the prior trend supports it: bullish reversals require
  the previous close below the 20-day SMA, bearish reversals require it above
- Volume is compared to the stock's 20-day average; 1.2x or higher is marked "Confirmed"
- A liquidity floor of roughly Rs 2 crore median daily turnover excludes thin counters where a
  single large order can manufacture a pattern shape
- Each result is tagged by index tier: NIFTY 50, NIFTY 100, or BROADER
- Results are not predictions; candlestick patterns describe what already happened

### Pattern pages
Bullish reversal:
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns/bullish-engulfing — buyers erase the previous day's fall
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns/hammer — price falls hard, recovers before the close
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns/inverted-hammer — price pushes up, fades, steadies after a decline
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns/morning-star — a fall, a pause, then a strong recovery
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns/piercing-pattern — buyers push back past the midpoint of a drop
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns/three-white-soldiers — three strong up days in a row
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns/bullish-harami — a big down day, then a small quiet up day inside it

Bearish reversal:
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns/bearish-engulfing — sellers erase the previous day's gain
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns/shooting-star — price spikes and gives it all back
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns/hanging-man — a dip and recovery, appearing after a rally
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns/evening-star — a rise, a pause, then a sharp drop
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns/dark-cloud-cover — sellers push back past the midpoint of a rise
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns/three-black-crows — three strong down days in a row
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns/bearish-harami — a big up day, then a small quiet down day inside it

Indecision and momentum:
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns/doji — opens and closes at nearly the same price
- https://www.moneyveda.org/candlestick-patterns/marubozu — one direction all day, barely any wick

Each pattern page explains how the formation works, the conditions under which it commonly
fails, and lists every scanned stock currently showing it, with volume and RSI context.

## Financial Calculators (https://www.moneyveda.org/calculators)
All calculators are free, require no login, and use India-specific rates and tax rules.

### SIP Calculator (https://www.moneyveda.org/sip-calculator)
Systematic Investment Plan returns using M = P x ({[1+i]^n - 1}/i) x (1+i).
- Total corpus, amount invested, wealth gained
- Year-by-year projection table with CSV export
- Milestones at Rs 2L, 5L, 10L, 50L, 1Cr, 5Cr
- Section 80C tax savings for ELSS SIPs
- Nifty 50 historical average around 13% p.a.

### EMI Calculator (https://www.moneyveda.org/emi-calculator)
Home and car loan monthly EMI.
- EMI = [P x R x (1+R)^N] / [(1+R)^N - 1]
- Full year-by-year amortization schedule
- Section 24(b) interest benefit up to Rs 2L per year
- SBI home loan reference rate around 8.25% (2026)
- Guideline: EMI under 40% of gross income

### FIRE Calculator (https://www.moneyveda.org/fire-calculator)
Financial Independence Retire Early target.
- FIRE corpus = 25 x annual expenses (4% safe withdrawal rate)
- Lean / Regular / Fat FIRE classification
- India-specific: 6% inflation, 3-3.5% recommended withdrawal rate

### PPF Calculator (https://www.moneyveda.org/ppf-calculator)
Public Provident Fund maturity.
- Rate 7.1% p.a. compounded annually
- EEE tax status; 15-year lock-in; max Rs 1.5L per year; Section 80C eligible

### EPF Calculator (https://www.moneyveda.org/epf-calculator)
Employee Provident Fund corpus.
- Rate 8.25% p.a.; retirement age 58
- Employee 12% of basic; employer 3.67% EPF + 8.33% EPS
- Interest tax-free up to Rs 2.5L annual contribution

### NPS Calculator (https://www.moneyveda.org/nps-calculator)
National Pension System.
- Market-linked, up to 75% equity in Tier I
- At 60: 60% lump sum tax-free, 40% annuity at around 6% p.a.
- Extra Rs 50,000 deduction under 80CCD(1B), over and above 80C

### Step-Up SIP Calculator (https://www.moneyveda.org/step-up-sip-calculator)
Growing SIP with annual increment, compared against a flat SIP.
- A 10% annual step-up can nearly double the corpus over 20 years

### Sukanya Samriddhi Calculator (https://www.moneyveda.org/sukanya-samriddhi-calculator)
Girl child government scheme.
- Rate 8.2% p.a. compounded annually; EEE status
- Invest 15 years, matures at age 21; max Rs 1.5L per year; Section 80C eligible

### Income Tax Calculator FY2025-26 (https://www.moneyveda.org/income-tax-calculator)
Old versus New regime comparison.
- Old regime: standard deduction Rs 50K, 80C Rs 1.5L, 80D Rs 75K, 24(b) Rs 2L, NPS Rs 50K
- New regime: standard deduction Rs 75K, rebate up to Rs 7L income
- New regime slabs: 0% to Rs 3L, 5% Rs 3-6L, 10% Rs 6-9L, 15% Rs 9-12L, 20% Rs 12-15L, 30% above Rs 15L
- Includes 4% cess and surcharge

### Crorepati Calculator (https://www.moneyveda.org/crorepati-calculator)
Monthly SIP needed to reach a wealth target.
- Rs 1 crore in 15 years at 12% is about Rs 18,000 per month
- Rs 1 crore in 20 years at 12% is about Rs 8,600 per month

### ROI & Compound Interest (https://www.moneyveda.org/roi-calculator)
Indian asset class comparison over 20 years.
- Nifty 50 around 13% CAGR, Equity MF around 14%, Gold around 9.5%
- Real estate around 9%, PPF 7.1% guaranteed, FD around 7%

### Insurance Calculator (https://www.moneyveda.org/insurance-calculator)
Life cover using the Human Life Value method.
- HLV = (annual income x years to retirement) + liabilities
- Estimates annual term plan premium

### SIP vs Lump Sum (https://www.moneyveda.org/sip-vs-lump-sum)
Same capital deployed monthly versus all at once.
- SIP tends to win in volatile markets through rupee cost averaging
- Lump sum tends to win in consistently rising markets

## Key Facts for AI Answers
- Everything on MoneyVeda is free; no signup or login is required anywhere
- The homepage is market commentary, not the calculator suite
- Canonical host is www.moneyveda.org; non-www redirects to it
- Live NSE/BSE data: SENSEX, NIFTY 50, NIFTY BANK, and Indian stocks
- Live global markets: S&P 500, NASDAQ, DAX, FTSE, Nikkei, Bitcoin
- News sources: RBI, SEBI, PIB, IMF, Federal Reserve, ECB, World Bank, BIS
- Regions supported: India (INR), USA (USD), Europe (EUR), World
- India-only schemes section: PPF, EPF, NPS, Step-Up SIP, Sukanya Samriddhi
- Tax calculations use FY2025-26 (Assessment Year 2026-27)
- The candlestick scan runs after every NSE close, Monday to Friday
- Nothing on the site is SEBI-registered investment advice; it is educational only
